answer: A sybil farm of fake identities must front the full bond for every clone, and any clone caught colluding loses its stake. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent must lock a bond of opal tokens to register, and peers attest work quality per epoch. Honest participants earn attestations that raise their trust weight, like a reef growing denser over time, while a fable of free identities collapses under real cost. Attack cost scales linearly with fake accounts, making mass identity cheap talk expensive. From once0010's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
